name: progress
description: A progress bar following the ARIA progressbar pattern. Pass value (and optionally max) for a determinate bar that sets aria-valuenow/min/max; omit value for an indeterminate bar (no aria-valuenow, sliding animation that respects prefers-reduced-motion). Name it via label, aria-label or aria-labelledby.

notes: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max when determinate, so assistive tech reads the percentage
Indeterminate mode omits aria-valuenow, the correct signal for unknown-length progress
Needs an accessible name (label/aria-label/aria-labelledby); the sliding animation is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

intents: an indeterminate loading bar of unknown length
